facts.fact: On 23 October 2009 the minister of Posts, Telephones and Telecommunications presented the sector policy document at a workshop that the World Bank director described as finalising the strategy; the article says the sector is about to have the document.
facts.system: Document de politique sectorielle des télécommunications et des TIC

facts.fact: The policy sets targets for 2015 of 33 million fixed and mobile lines (40% teledensity against about 10%) and at least 5% internet access against 1%, per the minister; no cost of the plan is given.
